page.overview:
Who is B.J. Hunnicutt?

Captain B.J. Hunnicutt was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

He was assigned to Starfleet Operational Support Services in 2364. Early that year, he sent an order to Captain Benjamin Franklin Pierce of the about the transportation of personnel from Starbase 55 to the . Hunnicutt requested Pierce to send acknowledgement of the receipt of this order through subspace com net security mode 045, code 100 alpha. (, okudagram)
